text.en:
The Ocmis Electric Service Company is granted an extension of thirty days, from the date of the
approval of this Act, to comply with the terms and conditions set forth in Acts Numbered Thirty-six hundred
and forty-five and Thirty-nine hundred and fifty-one relative to the acceptance of the franchise, the deposit
and other requirements under the said Acts granting the Ocmis Electric Service Company a franchise to install
and operate an electric plant in the municipality of Oroquieta, Province of Occidental Misamis: Provided,
however, That the said franchise shall be subject to the limitations provided in the Constitution of the
Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 9, 1938.
